# Sunshine Smiles Pediatric Dentistry

> > Sunshine Smiles Pediatric Dentistry provides comprehensive dental care for children in Melbourne, Florida, focusing on preventive care, early intervention, and creating positive dental experiences.

Sunshine Smiles is a pediatric dental practice in Melbourne, Florida led by Dr. Kristin and Dr. Alvarez, specializing in children's oral health from infancy through adolescence. The practice emphasizes preventive care, patient education, and evidence-based treatment following ADA and AAPD guidelines.

## Educational Blog

- [First Dental Visit For Children - How Early?](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/when-should-children-first-see-the-dentist): Guide on appropriate age for first dental visit and early childhood dental care based on ADA recommendations.
- [At What Age Does My Child Needs Braces?](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/at-what-age-does-my-child-needs-braces): Guide on orthodontic consultation timing for children around age 7-10 with parental recommendations.
- [Schedule, Set, Repeat](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/schedule-set-repeat): Article on recommended dental visit frequency for children and preventive care routine establishment.
- [Benefits of Early Dental Visits](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/benefits-early-dental-visits): Guide on benefits of early dental care, reducing anxiety, and preventing tooth decay in children.
- [All About Leading by Example](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/all-about-leading-by-example): Parenting guide on role-modeling healthy oral hygiene habits and brushing/flossing for children.
- [Chewing Gum: Good or Bad?](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/chewing-gum-good-bad): Educational article on sugar-free gum benefits, xylitol, and cavity prevention for children.
- [Why Are Digital X-Rays Best?](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/why-are-digital-x-rays-best): Educational content on digital X-ray technology benefits and safety in pediatric dental care.
- [Bad Breath Causes and Remedies](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/bad-breath-remedies): Article on causes and remedies for bad breath in children with oral hygiene recommendations.
- [Just Say No to Gummy Vitamins](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/sticky-truth-gummy-vitamins): Educational article on dental risks of gummy vitamins and cavity prevention for children.
- [Why You Should Clean Your Tongue](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/clean-your-tongue): Article on tongue cleaning importance for oral hygiene, bad breath, and cavity prevention.
- [Smile BIG This Summer](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/smile-big-this-summer): Seasonal guide on summer dental safety, sports injury prevention, and emergency dental care for kids.
- [An Open Letter to Serena Williams](https://www.sunshinesmilesfl.com/blog/open-letter-serena-williams): Open letter addressing teething and pediatric dentistry topics with celebrity mention reference.
